_comment: Read at startup (src/app/settings.ts). apiUrl and nuxeoBrowserUrl are where the BROWSER reaches Flexible GraphRAG and Nuxeo: same origin, through the proxy, so the Nuxeo session is shared. nuxeoBackendUrl is where the Flexible GraphRAG BACKEND reaches Nuxeo, server to server: keep it the same as the backend's NUXEO_URL. In Docker, the image sets it from KG_SPACES_NUXEO_BACKEND_URL.
_comment_enabledSources: Data sources the OTHER SOURCES tab offers. 'nuxeo' is left out: Nuxeo Web UI is the Nuxeo picker here.
